SELECT * FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT WHERE GAM_ACID='PA2910546' AND CUST_ID='A00148597'
SELECT AS_OF_DATE,DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS,* FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT WHERE GAM_ACID='PA2910546' AND CUST_ID='A00148597'
SELECT DATEPART(YEAR,CAST('2023-09-06' AS DATE))
